course.title: Stage 5 Textiles Technology
course.classification: Board Developed Course component / 100-hour elective pathway, non-VET
course.project: Upcycling; mini kimono; Quillow; costume; investigation/review
course.status: local network candidate; faculty approval required
course.authority_boundary: Teacher to confirm local timetable, assessment, practical authority, collaborative activity and gap extensions before delivery.

timetable.delivery_order: Preserved source sequence; local timetable to confirm

course_requirements.all_outcomes: All outcomes must be programmed for 100-hour and 200-hour courses.
course_requirements.course_100_hours: At least 2 textile projects, with associated folio documentation, selected syllabus content relevant to each project, and at least one collaborative activity.
course_requirements.course_200_hours: At least 4 textile projects, with associated folio documentation, all syllabus content, and at least one collaborative activity.
course_requirements.practical_majority: Practical experiences must make up the majority of the course and should be designed to be accessible to all students.

outcomes.statement: applies design processes and safe work practices to develop textile projects
communicates ideas, concepts and processes for textile design and production
investigates and evaluates design inspiration sources and textile products
explains industry practices and innovative technologies used in textile design and production
investigates and applies construction and decorative techniques to create textile products
justifies the selection and use of materials and technologies for textile design and production
analyses relationships between textile design, production and sustainability
